# =========================================================
# QUIZCRAFT — requirements.txt
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# WHY: no requirements file existed in this project — every
# dependency had been installed by hand into venv/, which makes
# the project impossible to set up reproducibly on another
# machine (or a deployment server). This file was generated from
# the exact package versions already installed in this project's
# own venv/, so `pip install -r requirements.txt` recreates the
# same environment.
#
# SETUP: python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate (Windows)
# or source venv/bin/activate (Mac/Linux), then:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
# =========================================================
